entries.task_id: kpurɛ kpurɛ|ba|aweren temɔ
entries.description: kpurɛ kpurɛ ba aweren temɔ
entries.subject: kpurɛ kpurɛ
entries.object: aweren temɔ

spans.text: Kpa bu ko mɛ̀ ba koo ko n wa kpurɛ kpurɛ ba aweren temɔ, bu girima doke bi ka tii mɔɔ te sua, kpa bu ka sɔm buru ko wuu si su waa yigbɛ te sɔɔn tɔmbun tii ka tem mɛ̀ ba mɔ min tɔmbu sɔɔ.

entries.task_id: kpuro marawa|ba|tii mɔ
entries.description: kpuro marawa ba tii mɔ
entries.subject: kpuro marawa
entries.object: tii mɔ

spans.text: Ba tɔmbu kpuro marawa ba tii mɔ, ba nɛ, girima ka saria sɔɔ.

Tɔmbu kpuro ba nɛwa woodan bera (swaa sɔɔ) n maa weenɛ tii yina bi ba ko ka be yina, bun saa tia bu ku goo suu wuna, n da ma ba saria ye sara, bu ka wa bu be taki di ka bu be nɔɔ kuuri be kpuro wooda ya ko be ganɛ.

spans.text: Ba ra bwisiku, ba dasabu mɔ, ma n weene ba n waasinɛ mɛrobisiru sɔɔ.

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere u saria mɔ ù win tem siru ye fɛagiru faaba kana ma ba wi toraa swɛɛ yi sɔɔ wooda ya wi nɔɔ ka.

entries.subject: tora te
entries.object: ma wi waasi tà ǹ gem

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere u saria mɔ, naa nɛbu wɔlluyee, ù win mem gere bu nɔɔ dee dee samaan nɔni, kpa siri yeru te ta ǹ gɔnnu ka yaa murenamɔ, tu wunana ù n gem mɔ, yè n win baa ka win tirasi, tora te ba ma wi waasi tà ǹ gem, sirikobu bu asaria ko.

spans.text: Tɔnu wi ba toraru waasi, ma ba ǹ gina ten see da nɔma tura, yen yɛro kun gina gɛɛ mɔ.

folded.id: ma|ba|yii bu (swaa kpee) ko nɛ tɔmbun waaru ta koo ka sosi
folded.subject: Ma
folded.object: yii bu (swaa kpee) ko nɛ tɔmbun waaru ta koo ka sosi

spans.text: Ma ba yii bu (swaa kpee) ko nɛ tɔmbun waaru ta koo ka sosi, kpa bu waaru gɔsia doonɔɔrugiru mi tii mɔra kon kpa,

folded.id: mɛ samaa|ya|yii mi sɔɔra tem dam mu tasa
folded.subject: Mɛ samaa
folded.object: yii mi sɔɔra tem dam mu tasa

spans.text: Mɛ samaa ya yii mi sɔɔra tem dam mu tasa.

folded.id: mɛnnɔ ka|yigbɛru|kó ta kun naanaanu ganu mɔ
folded.subject: mɛnnɔ ka
folded.object: kó ta kun naanaanu ganu mɔ

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere saria mɔ ù mɛnnɔ ka yigbɛru kó ta kun naanaanu ganu mɔ.

folded.id: mɔɔ ni|ba|kpara min baruka digoo kun tuko
folded.subject: mɔɔ ni
folded.object: kpara min baruka digoo kun tuko

spans.text: Baawere ko kpi u sariaba ka tii mɔɔ ni ba kpara min baruka digoo kun tuko, bwesera, wasin gɔna, durɔwa, kurɔwa, politikin beragia, n kun mɛ bwisikunu gana.

folded.id: mua saa|ba|ka sɔm bwese te eru mɔ́
folded.subject: mua saa
folded.object: ka sɔm bwese te eru mɔ́

spans.text: Tɔmbu kpuro, ba kɔsia teeru mɔ bu mua saa ba ka sɔm bwese te eru mɔ́.

folded.id: n weene|ba|n waasinɛ mɛrobisiru sɔɔ
folded.subject: n weene
folded.object: n waasinɛ mɛrobisiru sɔɔ

spans.text: Ba ra bwisiku, ba dasabu mɔ, ma n weene ba n waasinɛ mɛrobisiru sɔɔ.

folded.id: nde mɛ|ba|yen kpuna yii
folded.subject: nde mɛ
folded.object: yen kpuna yii

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere koo kpi ù samaa sɔmburu (bature sɔmburu) ko, nde mɛ ba yen kpuna yii.

folded.id: nɔm kɛrun|yigbɛru|tu wii dera
folded.subject: nɔm kɛrun
folded.object: tu wii dera

spans.text: Win sɔmburu tà n yɔra, ù n bara ù n yɛmɔ kua, ka sere yè u mɔ yà n buera n kun ka win gɔru kiru, u saria mɔ nɔm kɛrun yigbɛru tu wii dera.

folded.id: nɔɔsina yè|ya|waa ka tem tukun dam
folded.subject: nɔɔsina yè
folded.object: waa ka tem tukun dam

spans.text: Ka win tem kookari, ka mi nɔɔsina yè ya waa ka tem tukun dam, n wa win waaru tan girima mɔ.

folded.id: saa|ba|ka yen saka tura
folded.subject: saa
folded.object: ka yen saka tura

spans.text: Keu nɔman sɔm mɛɛribu gia ka gbankɔkɔ sɔm mɛɛeribugia n weenɛ bu n saa tɔmbu kpurongia, saa ba ka yen saka tura.

folded.id: sere mɛ|ba|koo wii yina
folded.subject: sere mɛ
folded.object: koo wii yina

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere u waarun saria mɔ ka tii mɔru, ka sere mɛ ba koo wii yina.

folded.id: taarɛ wɛ|ya|n kpaaru kere nde yè ba ko raa wii wɛ saa ye u tora
folded.subject: taarɛ wɛ
folded.object: n kpaaru kere nde yè ba ko raa wii wɛ saa ye u tora

spans.text: N ǹ weenɛ bu tɔnu taarɛ wɛ yèn sɔ u gaanu kua n kun mɛ yèn sɔ u gaanu duari ni nu ǹ waa toraru ka asarian swaa sɔɔ, sanamɛ u ni kua Yen biru, n ǹ weenɛ bu yɛro taarɛ wɛ ya n kpaaru kere nde yè ba ko raa wii wɛ saa ye u tora.

folded.id: te onu|ya|yii
folded.subject: te ONU
folded.object: yii

spans.text: N ǹ maa koorɔ bu asaria ye gbiisia ma win kookoosu kun saa dee dee n de mɛ yigbɛ baka te ONU ya yii.

folded.id: tee tera|ba|ko be ko
folded.subject: tee tera
folded.object: ko be ko

spans.text: Kurɔ wi na ka kurɔ kpaaru mɔ win bibu, ka wi na ǹ ka kurɔ kpaaru mɔ n bibu, be kpurɔ somi tee tera ba ko be ko.

folded.id: tora te|ba|ma wi waasi tà ǹ gem
folded.subject: tora te
folded.object: ma wi waasi tà ǹ gem

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere u saria mɔ, naa nɛbu wɔlluyee, ù win mem gere bu nɔɔ dee dee samaan nɔni, kpa siri yeru te ta ǹ gɔnnu ka yaa murenamɔ, tu wunana ù n gem mɔ, yè n win baa ka win tirasi, tora te ba ma wi waasi tà ǹ gem, sirikobu bu asaria ko.

folded.id: tɔn durɔ|ba|saria mɔ bu suana kpa bu bibu ma
folded.subject: tɔn durɔ
folded.object: saria mɔ bu suana kpa bu bibu ma

spans.text: Saa tɔnu saa gaa tura, ba ǹ bweseru garu, tem gam tɔndu, gusu nɔ saaru garu suu wunɛ, tɔn kurɔ ka tɔn durɔ ba saria mɔ bu suana kpa bu bibu ma.

folded.id: tɔnu wi|ba|toraru waasi
folded.subject: Tɔnu wi
folded.object: toraru waasi

spans.text: Tɔnu wi ba toraru waasi, ma ba ǹ gina ten see da nɔma tura, yen yɛro kun gina gɛɛ mɔ.

folded.id: turi mɛ|ba|kon ka waaru dimɔ dee dee
folded.subject: turi mɛ
folded.object: kon ka waaru dimɔ dee dee

spans.text: Wi u sɔmburu mɔ̀ kpuro u saria mɔ ù kɔriaru mua mɛ n weenɛ, sere tu wi win yɛnugibu turi mɛ ba kon ka waaru dimɔ dee dee, n koo koora buka be yina.

folded.id: ù|yigbɛru|garu du
folded.subject: ù
folded.object: garu du

spans.text: Ba ǹ goo tirasi mɔ̀ ù yigbɛru garu du.

folded.id: waa onun|yigbɛru|sɔɔ ba tɔnun asarian tii
folded.subject: Waa ONUN
folded.object: sɔɔ ba tɔnun asarian tii

spans.text: Waa ONUN yigbɛru sɔɔ ba tɔnun asarian tii, win girima ka win bɛɛrɛ, tɔn durɔ ka tɔn kurɔn nɛrabu (goo kun goo kere) kpam naanɛ kua.

folded.id: win baa|ya|waa kpuro
folded.subject: win baa
folded.object: waa kpuro

spans.text: Tɔnu baawere u saria mɔ u nɔm kɛru wa, mi win baa ya waa kpuro.

folded.id: win berusebu|ya|ǹ goo wa
folded.subject: win berusebu
folded.object: ǹ goo wa

spans.text: Tɔnun waarun gari, win yɛnu win nɔɔsina ka win berusebu ya ǹ goo wa.

folded.id: ye sɔɔ|ba|ko n da tɛtɛ to
folded.subject: ye sɔɔ
folded.object: ko n da tɛtɛ to

spans.text: Swaa ye sɔɔ ba ko n da tɛtɛ to, taki sari, sanam ka sanam, tɔmbu kpuron nɔni biru n kun mɛ bɔkusaɔ, bu ku goo tirasi ko u ka goo tɛtɛ toowa.

folded.id: yè|ya|kere yera bu nɔɔsina ka bu bɔrɔnu dam kɛ tem baa
folded.subject: yè
folded.object: kere yera bu nɔɔsina ka bu bɔrɔnu dam kɛ tem baa

spans.text: Nde mɛ̀ yè ya kere yera bu nɔɔsina ka bu bɔrɔnu dam kɛ tem baa,

folded.id: yè|ya|kere yera suam tem (tia) mɛ̀ tɔnun asaria ka win tii mɔrun swaa sɔɔ
folded.subject: Yè
folded.object: kere yera suam tem (tia) mɛ̀ tɔnun asaria ka win tii mɔrun swaa sɔɔ

spans.text: Yè ya kere yera suam tem (tia) mɛ̀ tɔnun asaria ka win tii mɔrun swaa sɔɔ, n wa mɛ̀ ba yii ba nɛ ba koo ko bu yè ko mam mam.

folded.id: yè|ya|kere yera tem mi ba wooda swii bu tɔnum asaria nɔni doke
folded.subject: yè
folded.object: kere yera tem mi ba wooda swii bu tɔnum asaria nɔni doke

spans.text: Nde mɛ̀ yè ya kere yera tem mi ba wooda swii bu tɔnum asaria nɔni doke, n wa tirasi yu ku wii deema ù ka tii yina yen sɔ ba wii yoru diisiamɔ ka ba wii takaasi mɔ̀,

folded.id: yen sɔ|ba|wii yoru diisiamɔ ka ba wii takaasi mɔ̀
folded.subject: yen sɔ
folded.object: wii yoru diisiamɔ ka ba wii takaasi mɔ̀

spans.text: Nde mɛ̀ yè ya kere yera tem mi ba wooda swii bu tɔnum asaria nɔni doke, n wa tirasi yu ku wii deema ù ka tii yina yen sɔ ba wii yoru diisiamɔ ka ba wii takaasi mɔ̀,
